title: The Giant Dwarf
start: Talk to Commander Veldaban in the Black Guard headquarters on the western side of Keldagrim. To enter Keldagrim, talk to the dwarf boatman in the dwarven mine east of Rellekka.

requirements.t: Standard spells equipped or the ability to cast Spellbook Swap

items.t: Any logs that you can set fire to
Runes to cast Telekinetic Grab (1 law rune and 1 air rune)
1 Redberry pie (not required if you have completed The Knight's Sword quest)

About 10 of each of the following items in your bank or metal bank, which may or may not be necessary for the timed delivery tasks. There is the Keldagrim bank and a metal bank access in Keldagrim, so you don't have to carry everything there. Once you're there, take the items out for use in the quest.

recommended.t: About 10,000 coins (may vary on the tasks you get during the quest)
21 Agility (for the underwall tunnel shortcut to the Grand Exchange)
Activated Port Sarim and Fremennik Province lodestone
Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring teleport to Keldagrim (accessible after initial city entry in quest introduction)

rewards.t: The ability to use the mine cart system to White Wolf Mountain (also requires completion of the quest Fishing Contest)
The ability to work for the company the player has chosen by completing tasks similar to the ones in the quest
The ability to use members-only gravestones, which last longer than the free-to-play gravestones

steps.t: Enter the tunnel between the two black statues, north-east of Rellekka, close to fairy ring DKS. (teleport to the Fremennik Province and run north-east)
Go through cave entrance east to Keldagrim.
Talk to the Dwarven Boatman inside the cave, not Dwarven Ferryman. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Go west to the Black Guard H.Q.. Enter the building and talk to Commander Veldaban. The chat instance should end with you accepting the quest. [Chat: Accept]
Exit the house, go north-east across the bridge and talk to Blasidar the Sculptor just north-west of the brewery. [Chat: 2 Yes, I will do this.]
In the large building just west, talk to Vermundi at the silk icon. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.]
In the building west of the northern bridge, talk to the Librarian. [Chat: 2 Do you know anything about King Alvis's clothes?]
While weighing less than 30kg, attempt to climb any bookcase (there's a bank south-west of the library if you're over the limit).
With the book, return to Vermundi. [Chat: 2 Yes, about those special clothes again...]
Use coal and logs on her spinning machine.
Try to light it until the engine starts. (This may take several attempts)
Talk to Vermundi. [Chat: 2 Yes, about those special clothes again... › 1 I'll pay.]
In the far west of the city, talk to Saro at the anvil icon. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.]
North of the bank, talk to Dromund.
Take the left boot, from the table near the door, while his back is turned.
Leave his house and run around to the north edge, stand next to the western window (adjacent to the right boot).
When his back is turned, cast Telekinetic Grab on the right boot through the window.
Go to the north-west corner and talk to Santiri. [Chat: 2 Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe. › 2 Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue. › 2 Perhaps I can repair the axe?]
Use 3 sapphires on the battleaxe.
If you have not completed The Knight's Sword:

sub.t: Take a redberry pie with you when you talk to Thurgo.

steps.t: Talk to Thurgo in his small hut (fairy ring AIQ), south of Port Sarim, and north of Mudskipper Point. [Chat: 2 Something else. (3 if skillcape is owned) › 2 Would you like some redberry pie? › 3 Can you help me with this ancient axe? › 1 Return to Keldagrim immediately.]

sub.t: If The Knight's Sword is complete [Chat: 2 Something else. (3 if skillcape is owned) › 2 Can you help me with this ancient axe? › 1 Return to Keldagrim immediately.]
Have an iron bar to give to Thurgo (or access your metal bank via the anvil next to Thurgo to obtain one which is stored in it).

steps.t: With the 4 items, talk to Riki the sculptor's model near Blasidar the sculptor.
Talk to Blasidar for a cutscene.
Run west to the marketplace (the biggest building in the map) building and up the stairs.

Talk to any secretary (yellow is closest to metal bank) - your character's gender may disqualify your eligibility to work for that colour of company, consequently try another colour. [Chat: 3 Is there anything I can help you with? › Any]
Fetch them the required ore (must be un-noted). Repeat with the same secretary for a total of 4 tasks.
Talk to the director. [Chat: 3 Do you have any more tasks for me? › Any]
Fetch them the required bars. You might need to repeat for a second task.
Talk to the director. [Chat: 2 I'd like to officially join your company. › 3 Blasidar the sculptor has sent me. › 1 I would support you. › 1 Yes! Long live the [company]!]
p: Hreidmar storms out of the Consortium meeting.

steps.t: Return to Commander Veldaban in Black Guard headquarters, where you started the quest (west of the palace and west of the bank). [Chat: 1 I'm ready. › 2 I do NOT want to attend, I don't have time to waste. › 2 I just have a lot of smithing to do today, I can't attend.]
Quest complete!

get_inside.text: First time from the Keldagrim entrance tunnel east of Rellekka.
The Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring provide unlimited teleports to the west side of the Palace floor 1.

Players with access to Keldagrim can use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to arrive in East Keldagrim. A luck ring such as the Ring of Wealth or higher variants can also teleport a short distance from the trapdoor using the Grand Exchange teleport option.

The master camouflage outfit provides unlimited teleports to the Consortium (0, 1), the top floor of the palace in the centre of Keldagrim. This allows convenient access to both the east and west side of Keldagrim. Other variants of this outfit will also teleport players to this location five times per day.
Players may buy a one-way rail cart ticket to Keldagrim from one of the cart conductors in the Dwarven Mine under White Wolf Mountain or a free train ride from Dorgesh-Kaan.

Players may also use the Fremennik Province lodestone, run north-east, and enter the cave entrance to the east with two statues. Once inside, there is another entrance with two statues directly in front of the player. Enter this, ignoring the long path.

Players who have level 99 in at least one skill, or are able to wear the Quest Cape can tune the skill portal in Max Guild to the Lava Flow Mine. The portal will teleport the player right next to the entrance to the city. It requires completion of King of the Dwarves.
